purpose: Index of the conditions fixed before the main computations of the paper (K4 in two dimensions, the paired edge-and-grid comparison, validation 3 on public data, K5, and the variants for the supplement). Each computation reads its condition file and records the SHA-256 of that file and of the specification in its results.
fixed_before_running: Committed on 2026-10-25 before any of the listed computations. Changes after this commit increase the version of the affected file, list the change under 'deviations' with its reason, and add a new entry to 'history' below without removing the old one.

earlier_conditions.note: Committed earlier with their results; Japanese originals are authoritative and unchanged; *.en.json are translations added afterwards.
earlier_conditions.observable_dof: Its settings (four octaves, no warp, maxabs, N = 128, product octaves) agree with the specification, so its results (commit 0f320bc) are used without recomputation.

second_opinion: Before this commit the plan was sent to an external model (Codex) for missing conditions and ambiguous criteria; the resulting revisions are listed under 'deviations_before_running' in each file.

history.reason: Version 1 stated that the 20 rule points with A != 0 have non-integer f; f = 5 + 2A is an integer at all 25 points. Five points with A = 0.25 (f = 5.5) were added as edge-discontinuity controls and P-E2 to P-E4 refer to them. Changed before the main computation of this file was run (see 'deviations' in the file).

The flip_positive control of version 2 could not produce the flip predicted by P-E7 (found by a code review before the run); its tones were replaced. Changed before the main computation of this file was run (see 'deviations' in the file).

Added under 'exploratory': a supplementary exploration of validation 3 designed after its results had been seen (reduction methods and the change of hf_ratio_phys with coarsening). It is not among the registered computations and is not used as evidence for the main claims.
Added: the predicted direction and order for every row of Table 1 of K5, written before any K5 computation. Not a change of k5_classification.json.

Added under 'exploratory': a supplementary exploration of K4 (b) designed after its results had been seen (N up to 16384, extrapolations of the local slopes, an estimate of the leading terms). It is not among the registered computations and is not used as evidence for the main claims.

Added: K2 and K6, the maximum gradient against N under T_gamma and T_{gamma,eps} at three points of the rule, the worked example tying eps to a printer, and the surfaces of Fig. 2. Written before any computation in this file; revised before this commit after independent checks (see 'deviations_before_running' in the file).

v3_reduction_supplement.json.note: Exploratory, designed after the results of validation 3; not blind; for the supplement only.

k4_supplement.json.note: Exploratory, designed after the results of K4 (commit cb369b4); not blind; for the supplement only. The slopes over the finite N ranges of Appendix B and the rejection of the estimate rest on K4 alone.

k5_table1_predictions.json.note: Predicted direction and order for Table 1 of K5, written from K1-K4 before any K5 computation. The conditions file is unchanged.
